name: DetalhesIndividuais-v1
prompt: Production-ready modular 2D game assets for Cyber Extraction catacombs. Match the approved reference's muted natural painted material finish and readable small scale, exact orthographic top-down game map camera, NEVER isometric. Neutral even light, no dramatic effects, no floor backgrounds. Exactly 6 independent small decoration sprites, strict equal 3 columns x2 rows sheet, true transparent background, no text or dividers. Row-major: 1 ONE small old iron stonecutting chisel, narrow worn tool lying flat, no hammer or floor; 2 ONE broken iron chain link with a SHORT second half-link beside its broken end, no coil or floor; 3 small group of three EXTINGUISHED old candle stubs with a little pooled cold wax, no shelf, pedestal, flame or glow; 4 ONE folded beige linen cloth with a narrow muted red ceremonial border, no metal bowl or support; 5 ONE tiny dull metal incense bowl viewed directly above with small perforated removable lid set at its rim, no cloth or smoke; 6 ONE torn dark charcoal mourning rag folded/draped low, no stone/wood support. Every object fully contained with at least48px clear margin inside its512x512 cell, no part may cross a cell boundary or cast shadows into neighboring cells.
